p='AKSES.md'; t=open(p).read()
t=t.replace("""| `CaptchaFoxTaskProxyLess` | diterima; data dummy gagal (butuh sitekey asli) |
| `AntiAwsWafTaskProxyLess` | diterima; data dummy gagal |""",
"""| `CaptchaFoxTaskProxyLess` | **OK** — GMX `sk_vKdD8WGlPF5FKpRDs1U4qTuu6Jv0w`, ~1,6 s |
| `AntiAwsWafTaskProxyLess` | **OK** — amazon.com; aws.amazon.com gagal |""")
t=t.replace("""### Catatan
- Solusi Turnstile ada di `solution.token`; reCAPTCHA di `solution.gRecaptchaResponse`.""",
"""### Catatan
- **WAJIB kirim `User-Agent`.** Tanpa UA -> `403 error code: 1010` (Cloudflare).
  Nilai bebas: `python-requests/2.34.2` maupun UA browser sama-sama lolos.
  `urllib` tanpa header UA = gagal; `requests` lolos karena punya UA default.
- Solusi Turnstile ada di `solution.token`; reCAPTCHA di `solution.gRecaptchaResponse`.
- **CaptchaFox ter-nested ganda**: `solution.solution.token` (bukan `solution.token`).
- **AntiAwsWaf** mengembalikan `token`, `cookie`, `captchaVoucher`, `userAgent`
  — keempatnya harus dipakai, bukan cuma token.
- Pakai `capsolve.py` (sudah jadi + teruji), bukan tulis curl manual.""")
open(p,'w').write(t); print("ok")
